issue_context.title: ESM output: single runtime chunk resolved to wrong path when using subpath entrys
issue_context.body: # Bug report **What is the current behavior?** If i create entrypoints that include a path in their name, when runtimeChunk: single is set - webpack imports the runtime from the wrong directory. **If the current behavior is a bug, please provide the steps to reproduce.** using this config: ```js module.exports = { output: { module: true }, target: ['es2022','async-node'], mode: "development", entry: { '/test/one': './counter', '/test/two': './example' }, optimization: { usedExports: true, concatenateModules: true, runtimeChunk: 'single' }, experiments: { outputModule: true } }; ``` Emits the following the `runtime.js` file is getting imported from `../../` instead of `../` **What is the expected behavior?** runtime chunk should resolve it correct location **Other relevant information:** webpack version: 5.74.0 Node.js version: 16 Operating System: OSX Additional tools:
comments: That seem to be caused by the leading `/` in the entry name
